label: Quanta of Space: A Manifesto
text: Known: the space filling by stella octangulas and octahedra; the cube, octahedron and stella octangula inscribed in the rhombic dodecahedron; the FCC primitive cell as a cube squashed along a diagonal. Lalvani, US 4,723,382 (1988): the window rhombus is one of its ten pieces; the Jewel's 48 walls lie 22.24° off every icosahedral two-fold axis. Pearce, US 3,974,600 (1976): struts with panels, not solid pieces. Not found (web search 9 October 2026; reference library 15 October 2026): a cube built from carved dodecahedra, or this block of eight. Not proof of novelty; no claim of priority. Also: Euclid, Elements XIII.17; Coxeter, Regular Polytopes.

label: Quanta of Space: A Manifesto
text: Known: the octet (tetrahedral-octahedral honeycomb); the rhombic dodecahedron as a cube with six pyramids and as an octahedron with eight quarter-tetrahedra; the cube as a tetrahedron with four corners; Knoll and Morgan 2003 (cube packing, octet and rhombic dodecahedron packing related as separate steps); power (Laguerre) diagrams (Aurenhammer 1987), whose power bisectors of the tetrahedron and octahedron centres are the cut planes here; Conway, Jiao and Torquato 2011; Gabbrielli, Jiao and Torquato 2012; Kelvin 1887; the uniform truncated cubic and rectified cubic honeycombs. Checked: DICTO's reference library (nothing on this family; Gabbrielli–Jiao–Torquato 2012 read for this check); Knoll and Morgan 2003 read in full; web searches, 23 October 2026 (cubes with four alternate corners truncated with octahedra; rhombic dodecahedra truncated at their three-fold corners with tetrahedra; power diagrams of the tetrahedral and octahedral holes of the face-centred cubic lattice; tetrahedra and octahedra of equal volume, cube root of 2), which found only the classical octet and its relatives. Not checked: Wolfram PolyhedronData, Stella / Great Stella libraries. Not found in those sources: the family as such, its two equilateral members, the half-and-half member, the Delian bond, and the golden division of the rhombic dodecahedron's pyramid by the polar golden bond. Scripts: study 2026-10-23-shadow-forms, commit 4e98aa8, github.com/DICTOR-Master/kaleidohedra (research branch). Doubling the cube: Heath 1921; ruler and compass impossibility: Wantzel 1837.
